definition.description: edgartools MCP server (uvx --from edgartools[ai]==5.61.1 edgartools-mcp): SEC EDGAR company profiles, filings, full-text search, XBRL financial trends, insider and institutional ownership, funds and proxy compensation (sec filings). SEC requires a declared identity (EDGAR_IDENTITY) and allows 10 requests/s. Cloud lanes need the streamable-http transport self-hosted.
